summary: Full backend regression for Hi Again Play Store Internal Testing launch. 22/22 pytest cases pass against the preview deployment (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). All 9 endpoints from the review request work end-to-end. Production (https://hiagain.xyz) was additionally smoke-tested: /api/health, /api/auth/login (cookie + access_token), /api/auth/me, /privacy, and /delete-account all return 200. No ObjectId leaks detected across 6 read endpoints. Nothing is broken.

minor.issue: Route does not exist in server.py. The actual endpoint is GET /api/subscription/status (returns tier + subscription + usage). The PRD / review request refers to /api/premium/status — the mobile client / future docs should use /api/subscription/status. Optionally add a /api/premium/status alias for naming clarity.

Pydantic response_model declares List[GatheringResponse] but the implementation actually returns a dict {my_gatherings: [...], upcoming: [...]}. FastAPI is letting it through because no Pydantic coercion is rejecting it, but the OpenAPI schema is misleading. Update the response_model or the return shape to match.

passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login — 200, returns access_token + user; sets httpOnly hiagain_token cookie
POST /api/locations — 200, returns id; created location echoed back; cleanup via DELETE works
POST /api/push/register with 64-char dummy FCM token — 200 {ok:true, push_enabled:bool}
ObjectId sweep on 6 read endpoints — no `_id` and no `$oid` leaks anywhere
Production smoke: /api/health 200, /api/auth/login 200 with cookie, /api/auth/me 200, /privacy 200, /delete-account 200 on https://hiagain.xyz
action_items: (Optional naming) Add a GET /api/premium/status alias that returns the same payload as /api/subscription/status, OR update PRD/docs to use /api/subscription/status. Current mobile bundle should call /api/subscription/status.
(Optional schema) Fix the response_model mismatch on GET /api/gatherings — either declare it as a dict response model or change the handler to return List[GatheringResponse].
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5,409 lines — already flagged in iteration_8, still not split. Should be broken into routers (auth, locations, crossings, subscription, gatherings, push) before any major feature work.
GET /api/gatherings response_model annotation does not match the actual returned shape. This will silently mislead OpenAPI consumers / mobile SDK generators.

Naming inconsistency: PRD/mobile-facing name is `premium` (e.g. /api/premium/status referenced in the review), but the implementation uses `subscription` (/api/subscription/status, /api/subscription/plans, /api/subscription/checkout). Pick one and document it.

POST /api/push/register: token min-length validation is `< 20` chars — real FCM tokens are ~163 chars so 20 is fine, but consider a slightly stricter check (>=140) and explicit platform whitelist (android/ios/web) for hardening.

Login endpoint returns BOTH access_token in the JSON body AND sets the httpOnly cookie. test_credentials.md says 'NO localStorage tokens' — but the body access_token makes it easy for mobile to accidentally store it. Either drop the body token (cookie-only for web, separate /api/auth/mobile-login for the app) or keep this dual-mode but document it.

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/22 pytest cases on preview; production smoke 5/5)
success_rate.frontend: not tested (review explicitly scoped to backend only)

seed_data_creation: None — the one test location created in POST /api/locations is deleted in the same test (TEST_City_Seattle + TEST_Pike_Place_<uuid>). One test push token is registered + unregistered in the same test (TEST_FCM_<uuid>). No residual state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run the suite with `cd /app && export $(grep -v '^#' frontend/.env | xargs) && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_play_store_regression.py -v`. Covers auth/login (cookie + body token), auth/me, locations CRUD subset, crossings, achievements, gatherings, subscription status (note: PRD calls it 'premium/status' but real route is 'subscription/status'), push register + unregister, public legal HTML pages, and a Mongo ObjectId leak sweep. Preview URL is the configured REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; production https://hiagain.xyz is also live and was smoke-tested.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two minor schema/naming inconsistencies flagged for cleanup.
